verdict.title: Turning down - not confirmed
verdict.meaning: Prices are falling on the 1H chart (and on 15m / 30m), but the bigger trend (4H / 1D) has not turned yet. The trend strategies wait: a SHORT alert comes only once 1H and 4H both point down.
fits: waiting for the confirmation - the SHORT alerts then come by themselves
checking the stop of any open long
avoid: buying the dip (catching a falling knife)
shorting by hand before the confirmation
